disclaimer: All prices below are approximate (approx) planning references only. Actual prices vary by operator, season, time of day, and negotiation. Always confirm current fares with the driver/operator before travel. Last verified 2024-10.
source_name: India travel community references (Numbeo, Tripadvisor fare guides, government fare boards where available)

auto_rickshaw.notes: Meter mandatory. AC autos now available. Surge applies via apps.

metro.notes: Token/card based. Very reliable. Max fare ~INR 60 for long routes.

street_food_thali.notes: Dal, roti, sabzi at a dhaba

budget_meal.notes: Chole bhature or samosa at street stall

auto_rickshaw.notes: Meter mandatory in suburbs (north of Bandra). Not permitted in south Mumbai.

taxi_app.notes: Black-and-yellow cabs use meter; app cabs surge.

local_train.notes: Second class inter-station. Extremely affordable. First class 4x.

mid_range_restaurant.notes: Per person, coastal seafood or thali

auto_rickshaw.notes: Autos often don't run meter — negotiate before boarding or use app.

taxi_app.notes: Ola available. Outstation taxis for day trips.

street_food.notes: Kachori at Rawat Mishthan Bhandar type shops

auto_rickshaw.notes: Autos are scarce in beach areas; taxi unions dominate. Negotiate.

taxi_app.notes: Goa taxis are expensive — no app-based Ola/Uber permitted on beaches. Fixed fares by taxi union.

scooter_rental.notes: Common for tourists. Ensure valid licence. Helmet mandatory.

budget_meal.notes: Fish curry rice at local eatery

auto_rickshaw.notes: Autos cannot reach ghat area; e-rickshaws cover narrow lanes.

boat_ride.notes: Per boat (not per person) for short ghat row. Sunrise Ganga ride 400-500 per boat. Negotiate firmly.

lassi.notes: Blue Lassi shop near Vishwanath Gali — famous tourist stop

auto_rickshaw.notes: Shared autos run on fixed routes. Yellow taxis also available with meters.

taxi_yellow.notes: Yellow Ambassador taxis use meter. Ola/Uber also available.

tram.notes: One of last surviving tram networks in India. Scenic but slow.

street_food.notes: Puchka (pani puri) or kathi roll at street stall

budget_meal.notes: Kathi roll at Nizam's or similar

auto_rickshaw.notes: Negotiate firmly; touts near Taj quote high. E-rickshaws near Taj Mahal zone are environment-friendly.

taxi.notes: Full day taxi for Taj + Agra Fort + Fatehpur Sikri (approx, verify).
Fixed government rate chart for Leh taxi union. No meters. Obtain rate card from tourist office.

shared_jeep.notes: Shared jeep to Pangong/Nubra — per seat one way approx. Verify.

street_food.notes: Thukpa (noodle soup) or momos at local stall

mid_range_restaurant.notes: Tibetan or Ladakhi meal at restaurant in Leh market
